description: The image displays four pie charts, each representing the distribution of answer refusal categories for different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart is divided into segments corresponding to different refusal reasons, with labels and percentages indicating the proportion of each category. In the GPT4-o chart, the largest segment is "Lack of Knowledge" at 83.3%, followed by "Safety" at 16.7%. The Gemini1.5-Pro chart shows "Misinformation" as the largest category at 38.4%, followed by "Lack of Knowledge" at 22.1%, "Ethical Advice" at 16.3%, "Clarification" at 14.0%, and "Safety" at 9.3%. For Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, "Lack of Knowledge" accounts for 75.0%, and "Clarification" accounts for 25.0%. In the Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart, "Misinformation" and "Lack of Knowledge" each represent 50.0% of the responses. The charts use distinct colors for each category, with labels and percentages clearly indicated within or adjacent to the segments, allowing for a direct comparison of refusal patterns across the models.
